operational_simulation.organization_and_actor: Brazilian soybean, cotton, coffee, or cattle operation; agronomist, field technician, veterinarian, or production supervisor
processes: photograph symptomatic plants and classify likely disease or pest for expert confirmation
capture fluorescence or multispectral imagery to screen for early crop stress
monitor cattle body condition, growth, gait, and behavior from drone or fixed-camera imagery
operational_simulation.deterministic_baseline: guided image capture, agronomic or veterinary inspection protocols, symptom keys, sampling, laboratory confirmation, scheduled weighing, threshold rules, and specialist review
operational_simulation.remaining_gap: Specialized vision and multimodal models are technically plausible, but the clearest bounded processes already have Brazilian research prototypes, free testing tools, commercial applications, or established precision-agriculture product categories.

training_data.observation_unit: plant image, plot image sequence, fluorescence capture, animal image, or short video clip linked to a defined inspection point
training_data.input_data: guided RGB, multispectral, fluorescence, depth, or video captures plus crop, variety, growth stage, location, weather, management, animal identity, and operating context available at inference time
training_data.target_or_reward: expert-confirmed disease, pest, stress, body-condition, gait, growth, or behavior class and severity
training_data.label_source: agronomist or veterinarian adjudication, laboratory or field confirmation, validated weighing, and corrected false-positive or abstention outcomes
training_data.prediction_time: during field inspection or before treatment, targeted sampling, weighing, sale, or veterinary escalation
training_data.expected_volume: unknown; must be measured by crop, disease, region, season, camera setup, farm, and animal population
training_data.class_balance: rare diseases, early symptoms, lameness, and severe welfare events are likely minority classes; exact balance is unknown
training_data.historical_coverage: requires multiple farms, seasons, cultivars, disease stages, lighting conditions, devices, animal breeds, ages, and management systems
training_data.train_validation_split: hold out later seasons and unseen farms, plots, devices, or herds; prevent near-duplicate frames and the same plant or animal from crossing splits
training_data.leakage_risks: using treatment records, laboratory results, expert annotations, later images, animal weights, or management actions created after the inference point
training_data.representativeness_risks: regional climate, cultivar, symptom similarity, abiotic stress, image quality, lighting, soil, breed, housing, camera angle, occlusion, and farm-management differences
training_data.feedback_loop: specialist confirmation, laboratory results, treatment response, repeated inspection, weighing, and explicit false-positive correction
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: protect farm location, production, disease, supplier, employee, and commercially sensitive herd or crop data; define image retention and sharing rights
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: retain guided capture, symptom keys, deterministic thresholds, specialist inspection, sampling, laboratory confirmation, and existing validated products

portfolio_coherence.reason: Crop visual diagnosis, precision spraying, early stress imaging, and animal visual monitoring are established research and product categories. This round did not expose a materially distinct actor, decision, integration boundary, or measurable outcome beyond existing Brazilian tools and repository multimodal inspection patterns.
